Carmen (content): Post-launch tidy: tiny list please — redirects for old promos, JSON-LD event + breadcrumb, internal link weaving to benchmarks, and a quick keyword sync for CTA copy. 48h watch.

Theo (seo): Good call. Top priorities: 1) 301 legacy promo -> /webinar-serve-scale 2) self-referential canonical on new page 3) Event + BreadcrumbList JSON-LD only on landing 4) add 5 contextual links from pillar pages (benchmarks, pricing, docs).

Priya G.: For messaging, let's fold "inference cost" and "latency benchmarks" into one H2 and test CTAs: A) "Watch: Serving at Scale" B) "See latency & cost benchmarks". Recommend 65/35 to benchmarks.

Marta (eng): Need exact legacy paths and param whitelist for redirects. Also decide whether shortlink /go/serve is 302 temporarily.

Carmen (content): Legacy list: /promo/serve-demo, /events/serve-preview, /blog/expectations-serve. Shortlink: /go/serve. Keep utm_source & utm_campaign; drop legacy_sid and session_id.

Marta (eng): nginx sketch for staging: ```# legacy exact
location = /promo/serve-demo { return 301 https://redwood.inference/webinar-serve-scale?$query_string; }
rewrite ^/events/serve-preview(.*)$ /webinar-serve-scale$1 permanent;```
I'll make /go/serve a 302 for 72h then flip to 301 per marketing.

Theo (seo): JSON-LD (put in <head> on the landing only): ```{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Redwood Inference: Serving at Scale","startDate":"2026-07-14T17:00:00Z","url":"https://redwood.inference/webinar-serve-scale","organizer":{"@type":"Organization","name":"Redwood Inference"}}```. Add a BreadcrumbList snippet too.

Priya G.: For anchors: add an inline link from /benchmarks with anchor "inference latency benchmarks"; from /pricing use "cost of inference"; from /docs/optimize use "reduce token cost". Will upload CSV.

Carmen (content): QA checklist after staging deploy: crawl old URLs -> expect 301, validate JSON-LD with Rich Results test, check canonical, audit anchors live, confirm GA captures utm_campaign on form submit.

Marta (eng): Deploy plan: push rules to staging, run CI smoke, tag this channel. Rollback = comment redirect block + reload nginx + CDN purge. I'll include clear rollback steps in the PR.

cdn-bot: Staging edge purge scheduled after redirect deploy.

Theo (seo): Also suggest a quick pre/post link equity snapshot (export organic landing pages linking to old promos) so we can measure consolidation.

Priya G.: I'll run the CTA A/B and report CTR + conversions at 72h. Route 65% to benchmarks copy.

Carmen (content): Owners: redirects=Marta, anchors=Priya, schema=Theo, monitoring=ops. Keep changes surgical to avoid index churn. Ping here when staging is green. :white_check_mark:

Marta (eng): Noted. Tagging eng-oncall for 48h watch window after flip.

Carmen (content): Thanks — small but important. If we see unexpected 404 spikes, revert and re-evaluate anchor updates.
